# fsr — Freedcamp Script Runner
Last updated: 2026-06-20


fsr (installed as the npm package `fscr`) is a free, open-source CLI tool that replaces your `package.json` scripts with a single documented Markdown file called `fscripts.md`. The file is simultaneously your documentation AND your script runner — docs and code literally cannot drift apart.

## What problem does fsr solve?

- `package.json` scripts have no room for documentation — 40+ cryptic one-liners with no context
- README docs drift away from the actual scripts within days of being written
- No one knows what the scripts do without asking the person who wrote them

## How to install

```bash
npm i -g fscr
```

## 3-command quick start

```bash
npm i -g fscr       # install globally
fsr generate        # auto-import package.json scripts into fscripts.md with doc stubs
fsr                 # open the interactive picker, pick a script, run it
```

## Key features

- **Interactive picker** — `fsr` opens an arrow-key picker showing every script with its human-readable description
- **Interactive navigation modes** — `fsr start` (browse by category) · `fsr scripts` (package.json scripts only) · `fsr list` (fuzzy search all tasks)
- **Full JavaScript blocks** — Write multi-line JavaScript directly inside Markdown fenced code blocks; run with `fsr run [task]`
- **Auto-generate from package.json** — `fsr generate` imports all existing scripts with documentation stubs
- **Parallel execution** — `fsr run-p start:web start:api` runs scripts concurrently with no extra tools
- **Sequential execution** — `fsr run-s clean build:prod deploy:staging` runs scripts in order
- **Plugin hook system** — Hook into `pre-task` and `post-task` events with custom plugins
- **Plugin discovery** — `fsr plugins` lists all installed plugins (built-in and npm `fscr-plugin-*`)
- **File encryption** — `fsr encrypt` / `fsr decrypt` for AES-encrypted `.env` files
- **Interactive encrypt/decrypt menu** — `fsr encryption` for guided interactive mode
- **System doctor** — `fsr doctor` / `fsr doctor --fix` / `fsr doctor --verbose` diagnoses and auto-fixes environment problems
- **AI-powered commits** — `fsr commit` stages and commits changes with AI-generated conventional commit messages
- **Auto Table of Contents** — `fsr toc`
- **Version bump** — `fsr bump`
- **Smart package upgrades** — `fsr upgrade`
- **Shell tab completions** — `fsr completion install` / `fsr completion uninstall` / `fsr completion status` / `fsr completion generate`; use `--shell` / `-s` to target a specific shell (bash, zsh, fish, powershell)
- **Git branch validation** — `fsr branch`
- **History clearing** — `fsr clear`
- **Environment profiles** — `fsr --env <name>` / `fsr -e <name>` filters visible and runnable tasks by deployment target (e.g., `fsr --env staging`, `fsr --env production`)

## Pricing

fsr is completely free and open source (MIT license). There are no paid plans.

## How fsr compares to alternatives

| Feature | package.json | README + npm | Makefile | fsr |
|---------|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| Docs next to scripts | ❌ | ❌ | ⚠️ | ✅ |
| Interactive picker | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Full JS script blocks | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Parallel execution | ❌ | ❌ | ⚠️ | ✅ |
| Plugin hooks | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| File encryption | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Zero config setup | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ |
| JS / Node native | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ |
| Docs can drift | ✅ always | ✅ always | ⚠️ | ❌ never |
